title.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭任 Nvidia 執行長
title.en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO

summary.zh-TW: AI 晶片龍頭最高領導人即刻離任。美股 Nvidia 收跌，台股隔天卻反彈，是觀察「同一事件、不同市場反應」的典型案例。
summary.en: The AI chip leader's chief executive left with immediate effect. Nvidia fell in the US, yet Taiwan stocks rebounded the next day: a clear case of one event drawing different market reactions.

facts.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效；財務長 Colette Kress 出任臨時執行長。
facts.en: Huang stepped down as president, CEO and director, effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO.

facts.zh-TW: Harvey C. Jones 出任 Nvidia 首任董事會主席，主導新執行長遴選，人選將考慮公司內外部。
facts.en: Harvey C. Jones became Nvidia's first board chair and will lead the search, weighing internal and external candidates.

facts.zh-TW: 辭任原因各媒體報導不一，本站不轉述未經證實的指控。
facts.en: Reported reasons vary across outlets; we don't repeat unverified allegations.

work.zh-TW: 據自由財經報導，Nvidia 董事會表示公司營運、客戶承諾與產品路線圖預期不受影響。
work.en: According to Liberty Times Finance, Nvidia's board said operations, customer commitments and the product roadmap are expected to be unaffected.

work.zh-TW: 目前未見 CUDA 等開發工具或授權條款的變更公告；觀察重點是新任執行長人選與產品策略是否延續。
work.en: No changes to CUDA or other developer tools or licensing have been announced. Worth watching: who the next CEO is and whether product strategy holds.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 重大新聞發生後，常出現假冒新聞連結或「內幕消息」的釣魚信與詐騙投資訊息。
securityPatterns.en: Big news is routinely followed by phishing that poses as news links or "inside information", and by investment scams.

move.zh-TW: 一度跌逾 700 點，收漲 548 點

move.en: opened +1.46%, up over 1,200 points in early trade

basis.en: Nov 13 early trade, not a close

views.zh-TW: 中央社將台股 11/13 的走高描述為「短期利空出盡」的反應。
views.en: CNA described Taiwan's Nov 13 rise as a reaction to the bad news being priced in.

views.zh-TW: 自由財經報導，投資人資金轉向 AMD 與博通等 Nvidia 競爭對手，兩者皆上漲超過 5%。
views.en: Liberty Times Finance reported investors moving into Nvidia rivals AMD and Broadcom, both up more than 5%.

caveats.zh-TW: 同一週美國消費者物價指數高於預期，市場也在等待生產者物價指數，這些總體因素同樣影響股價。
caveats.en: US consumer prices came in above expectations that week and producer prices were still due; such macro factors also move stocks.

caveats.zh-TW: 台股 11/12 的下跌發生在正式宣布之前，當時市場已有相關人事傳聞，不能全部歸因於這次宣布。
caveats.en: Taiwan's Nov 12 drop came before the official announcement, while personnel rumors were already circulating, so it can't all be attributed to the announcement.

caveats.zh-TW: Nvidia 股價在宣布前一個月已下跌超過兩成。
caveats.en: Nvidia's stock had already fallen more than 20% over the prior month.

title.zh-TW: Outlook 零時差漏洞遭實際利用
title.en: Outlook zero-day exploited in the wild

summary.zh-TW: 企業每天都在用的 Outlook 出現已遭利用的漏洞，可能外洩登入憑證。分數不高，卻是本月唯一已遭利用的微軟漏洞。
summary.en: Outlook, used across workplaces every day, has an exploited flaw that can leak sign-in credentials. Its score is modest, yet it's the only exploited Microsoft flaw this month.

facts.zh-TW: 微軟 11/10 例行更新修補 CVE-2026-124194，屬於 Outlook 欺騙漏洞，CVSS 6.5，微軟確認已遭利用。
facts.en: Microsoft's Nov 10 update fixed CVE-2026-124194, an Outlook spoofing flaw rated CVSS 6.5 that Microsoft confirmed is being exploited.

facts.zh-TW: 開啟特製的郵件檔案時，Outlook 可能在未警告的情況下連線到外部伺服器，外洩使用者的 NTLMv2 雜湊值。
facts.en: Opening a crafted message file can make Outlook connect to an outside server without warning, leaking the user's NTLMv2 hash.

facts.zh-TW: 美國 CISA 已列入已遭利用漏洞清單，要求聯邦機構於 11/24 前完成修補。
facts.en: CISA added it to its known-exploited list, giving federal agencies until Nov 24 to patch.

work.zh-TW: IT 部門可能推送 Office 更新並要求重新啟動 Outlook；建議確認更新確實已安裝到自己的電腦上。
work.en: IT may push Office updates and ask you to restart Outlook. Check that the update has actually landed on your machine.

work.zh-TW: 在修補完成前，對來路不明的附件或郵件檔案要特別小心。
work.en: Until it's patched, be especially careful with unexpected attachments and message files.

securityFacts.zh-TW: 資安媒體建議除了安裝更新，也考慮限制對外的 NTLM 驗證與連往不受信任主機的 SMB 連線。
securityFacts.en: Security outlets advise installing the update and also limiting outbound NTLM authentication and SMB connections to untrusted hosts.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 外洩的 NTLM 雜湊值常被用於中繼攻擊或離線破解，進一步取得帳號存取權。
securityPatterns.en: Leaked NTLM hashes are commonly used in relay attacks or cracked offline to gain account access.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 重大漏洞公開後，常出現假冒「緊急更新」的釣魚信，要求使用者點連結或下載檔案。
securityPatterns.en: After a major flaw goes public, fake "urgent update" emails asking users to click links or download files are common.

caveats.zh-TW: 我們未找到將當天跌幅與此漏洞或例行更新連結的報導，因此不推論兩者有因果關係。
caveats.en: We found no reporting linking that day's drop to this flaw or the update, so we draw no causal link.

caveats.zh-TW: 例行安全更新每月都會發布，通常不被市場視為重大事件。
caveats.en: Security updates ship every month and usually aren't treated as major market events.

caveats.zh-TW: 台股方面沒有直接相關的上市公司，因此不列出。
caveats.en: No directly related company is listed in Taiwan, so none is shown.
